title: Organizational Cybersecurity Leadership
text: A single leader is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity within an organization.

title: Asset Inventory
text: Maintain regularly updated inventory of all organizational assets with IP addresses, including OT, updated monthly.

title: OT Cybersecurity Leadership
text: A single leader is responsible and accountable for OT-specific cybersecurity within an organization.

title: Improving IT and OT Cybersecurity Relationships
text: Organizations sponsor at least one social gathering annually focused on strengthening relationships between IT and OT security personnel.

title: Mitigating Known Vulnerabilities
text: All known exploited vulnerabilities in internet-facing systems are patched or mitigated within a risk-informed timeframe.

title: Third-Party Validation
text: Third parties regularly validate cybersecurity defenses through penetration tests, bug bounties, or incident simulations.

title: Supply Chain Incident Reporting
text: Contracts stipulate vendors notify organizations of security incidents within a risk-informed timeframe.

title: Supply Chain Vulnerability Disclosure
text: Contracts require vendors notify organizations of confirmed security vulnerabilities within a risk-informed timeframe.

title: Vendor/Supplier Cybersecurity Requirements
text: Procurement documents include cybersecurity requirements evaluated during vendor selection.

title: Changing Default Passwords
text: Enforce organization-wide policy requiring changing default manufacturer passwords before deployment.

title: Minimum Password Strength
text: Enforce system policy requiring minimum password length of 15+ characters for IT and OT assets.

title: Unique Credentials
text: Provision unique and separate credentials for similar services; users cannot reuse passwords across accounts.

title: Revoking Credentials for Departing Employees
text: Enforce administrative process by employee departure date revoking physical access and disabling user accounts.

title: Separating User and Privileged Accounts
text: No user accounts have administrator privileges; administrators maintain separate accounts for non-administrative tasks.

title: Network Segmentation
text: All OT network connections denied by default; necessary IT-OT communications pass through monitored intermediary.

title: Detection of Unsuccessful Login Attempts
text: Log all unsuccessful logins and alert security teams after specific consecutive failed attempts occur.

title: Basic Cybersecurity Training
text: Provide at least annual training covering phishing, email compromise, operational security, and password practices.

title: OT Cybersecurity Training
text: Personnel securing OT receive specialized OT-focused cybersecurity training at least annually.

title: Strong and Agile Encryption
text: Deploy properly configured SSL/TLS protecting data in transit when technically feasible.

title: Phishing-Resistant MFA
text: Implement MFA using strongest available method, prioritizing hardware-based phishing-resistant options.

title: Disable Macros by Default
text: System-enforced policy disabling Microsoft Office macros by default on all devices.

title: Document Device Configurations
text: Maintain accurate documentation of baseline and current configuration details of all critical IT and OT assets.

title: Secure Sensitive Data
text: Sensitive data and credentials not stored in plaintext; accessible only by authenticated, authorized users.

title: Email Security
text: Enable STARTTLS, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC set to "reject" on all corporate email infrastructure.

title: Document Network Topology
text: Maintain accurate documentation of network topology across all IT and OT networks with periodic reviews.

title: Hardware and Software Approval Process
text: Require approval before new hardware, firmware, or software installation; maintain allowlist of approved items.

title: System Backups
text: Regularly backup all systems necessary for operations at least annually; store separately and test annually.

title: Incident Response Plans
text: Maintain, practice, and update IT and OT cybersecurity incident response plans for threat scenarios annually.

title: Log Collection
text: Collect access and security-focused logs for detection and incident response; notify when critical sources disable.

title: Secure Log Storage
text: Store logs in central system accessible only by authorized, authenticated users; retain per risk guidelines.

title: Prohibit Connection of Unauthorized Devices
text: Maintain policies preventing unauthorized media and hardware connection via USB disabling or port securing.

title: No Exploitable Services on Internet
text: Assets on public internet expose no exploitable services; unnecessary OS applications and protocols disabled.

title: Limit OT Connections to Public Internet
text: No OT assets on public internet unless explicitly required; exceptions documented with additional protections.

title: Detecting Relevant Threats and TTPs
text: Document list of relevant threats and maintain ability to detect instances via rules, alerting, or prevention systems.

title: Vulnerability Disclosure/Reporting
text: Maintain public, discoverable method for security researchers to notify organizations of vulnerabilities.

title: Deploy Security.txt Files
text: All public-facing web domains have security.txt file conforming to RFC 9116 recommendations.

title: Incident Reporting
text: Maintain codified policy on reporting confirmed cybersecurity incidents to external entities and CISA.

title: Incident Planning and Preparedness
text: Develop, maintain, and execute plans to recover and restore mission-critical assets impacted by incidents.
